short_partA.text: What kind of future do you imagine for yourself?
Imagine using your IT skills to build a career in Japan and grow into an international IT engineer.
Today, that opportunity is becoming a reality through the Japanese IT Pathway Program.
The Japanese IT Pathway Program prepares Cambodian IT students for professional careers in Japan.
Students develop two essential skills: Japanese communication skills and practical IT skills.
They also learn professional communication, teamwork, problem-solving, and Japanese workplace culture.
Our goal is to develop IT professionals who can succeed in an international environment.
There is something very important that every student should understand.
This opportunity did not happen by accident.
The Cambodian government wants young people to gain international experience, develop their abilities, and contribute to Cambodia's future.
With support and financial investment from the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, M P T C, this program became possible.
This is a special educational opportunity supported by the Cambodian government.
The government is investing in education because it believes in your potential.

short_partB.text: Through this program, you can receive specialized education with strong government support.
Your teachers, your university, Next Make, and the government are all working together to support your growth.
But there is one thing nobody else can provide for you.
Learning Japanese and developing IT skills require effort.
Attend your classes, ask questions, and keep practicing every day.
Every small effort brings you closer to your goals.
These students show us how being punctual and studying every day can lead to remarkable growth.
The Cambodian government, your university, and Next Make are here to support you.
Now, the next step is yours.
Appreciate this opportunity, and commit yourself to learning.
Your future starts with your commitment.
Welcome to the Japanese IT Pathway Program.
